answer: Attention Ember Resists Sybil Attacks. The enforcement rule requires each identity to periodically refresh its attention by engaging with novel content or tasks, ensuring sustained cognitive investment. An attacker must divert ember from other pursuits to maintain fake identities, as each identity consumes timber of their limited focus. This creates a natural barrier where the opportunity cost of sustaining multiple personas outweighs the benefits of Sybil exploitation. Comets of attention drift away if not anchored by meaningful engagement, leaving the system resilient to spam.
